text.title: FreshDrop, grocery delivery, September 2026
text.pattern: No. 17 of 55: subscription, pay per period instead of per order
text.logic: Buyers pay a monthly fee for free delivery; FreshDrop earns on the basket and the fee; buyers order more often
text.now_who: Moscow families, one-off orders; 1 in 4 never comes back
text.new_who: Same families on a monthly plan; 40% of buyers subscribe
text.now_what: groceries delivered per order; 199 RUB delivery fee each time
text.new_what: unlimited delivery for 499 RUB a month; same baskets
text.now_how: dark stores pick each order; couriers paid per drop
text.new_how: dark stores batch plan orders; couriers get a weekly bonus
text.new_value: 499 RUB fee plus margin on the basket; target margin 12%
text.decision: Test the monthly plan with 2,000 families in 3 districts from 1 November
text.check: Churn after month 1 (target below 15%); cannibalised free deliveries; the effect on basket size is not proven
